response.rationale: Tier B with 19 orders in 28 days gives moderate but not strong evidence, so the CLEARS verdict deserves partial trust. However, the shrunk realised dROAS (1.72) sits roughly 23% below the 2.22 goal, meaning efficiency headroom is thin before this raise; a full +10% step risks pushing the cell further from target. Dampening to ~70% of the proposed raise (an effective ~+7% bid) balances respecting the mechanical clearance against the below-goal efficiency signal, with moderate confidence given no explicit volatility data was provided.
